author: Luis C. Medina
title: Some Good Injury News: Luther Burden III and Darnell Wright Were Back at Practice - NewsBreak
text:
By Luis C. Medina ,
1 days ago Some much-needed good news on the injury report dropped on Wednesday with the return of Chicago Bears standouts Luther Burden III and Darnell Wright to the practice field.
Seeing this hit the timeline brought a smile to my face:
Bears Get Luther Burden III and Darnell Wright Back at Practice For Burden, this was his first appearance at Bears practice since suffering a groin injury on Aug. 8. There has long been a belief that the rising second-year wide receiver would be back in time to be a full go for the team’s Week 1 showdown against the Carolina Panthers. His participation in practice activities on Wednesday is an important step in the right direction. I’ll be curious to see if (and how much) he will practice in joint sessions with the Tennessee Titans on Thursday before the two teams square off in the preseason finale.
There are plenty of high hopes for Luther Burden III going into this season. His importance to the Bears’ offence is something we discussed here earlier in August.
Jul 31, 2026; Lake Forest, IL, USA; Darnell Wright walks on the field during Training Camp at Halas Hall. Mandatory Credit: Kamil Krzaczynski-Imagn Images That we are getting more good news on the Darnell Wright front also brings me joy. Wright left Tuesday’s practice early with an apparent elbow injury. If you’ll recall, Wright missed a game last due to an elbow ailment. So seeing him back at practice one day after dealing with an issue is pretty much the best-case scenario. Chris Emma ( 104.3 The Score ) notes that Wright wore a brace on his elbow, but “appeared to perform without restrictions” despite wearing it. Phew .
Wednesday’s practice was a light one before the Bears travelled to Nashville for Thursday’s joint practice session. But getting some light work in is better than the alternative. Hopefully, we will have more good news to share tomorrow.
